turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Oliver calling from Acme Life Cover. I'm returning a call back request about our life cover. Before we go any further, I should let you know this call is recorded for training and quality purposes. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hello, yes. Sorry, you said Acme? And it's recorded? That's fine.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's right, Acme Life Cover, and yes, it's recorded. I've got your request here, Mr Ali. You put in some details online. You're 61, a non-smoker, living in Leicester, and you were looking at around £60,000 of cover. Is that still roughly what you had in mind?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, I think so. My daughter helped me fill it in. I had a stroke in the spring, you see, so I'm a bit slow with things now. Sometimes I need things said twice.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that, and thank you for telling me. That's absolutely fine. I'll go slowly, and please stop me any time you want something repeated. There's no rush at all on this call.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Thank you. That helps.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Before I suggest anything, could you tell me a little about why you're looking at life cover, and who you'd want it to help?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: It's my wife, Samira. After the stroke I started thinking, if something happens to me, I don't want her left with the funeral and the bills. We've a small amount left on the mortgage, about thirty thousand. And I want something for the funeral too.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That makes a lot of sense. So it's mainly the remaining mortgage, around £30,000, plus funeral costs and perhaps a bit of breathing room for Samira. Are you still working at the moment, or retired?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Retired now. Since the stroke. I have my pension, and Samira works part time at the school.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is the monthly cost important to you? Is there a figure you'd be comfortable with each month?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I'd like to keep it under thirty pounds if I can. Money's a bit tighter now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Understood. Let me explain how the cover works, and I'll do it in small pieces. First, you can choose cover anywhere from £25,000 up to £500,000. Second, there's no medical exam. Instead, I'll ask you a few health questions, and whether we can accept you depends on those answers. Does that make sense so far?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Sorry, could you say the bit about the questions again?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Of course. There's no doctor's appointment and no medical test. I just ask you a few questions about your health over the phone. Based on your answers, we either accept you or we don't. Because of your stroke, I can't promise acceptance before we go through them.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Right. Questions on the phone, no doctor. Okay, I've got that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Now the next part is really important, so I'll go slowly. In the first 12 months of the policy, only accidental death is covered. So if you died from an illness in that first year, including another stroke, the policy wouldn't pay out. After 12 months, you're covered for death from illness as well. Could you tell me in your own words what that means for you?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: So... the first year, only if it's an accident. Like a car crash. Not if I'm ill. After a year, it covers everything... well, illness too.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's exactly right. The other things to know are that the premium is fixed, so it won't go up for the whole length of the policy. And you get 30 days to change your mind after it starts, with a full refund if you cancel in that time.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Fixed price, and thirty days to cancel. Good.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Mr Ali, as there's quite a lot here, would you like me to call back another day when your daughter or Samira could be on the call with you? I'm very happy to do that, and there's no pressure to decide today.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: That's kind. But my daughter and I talked it all through last week. She told me about the first year rule as well. I'd like to go ahead today if the price is right.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: That's fine, and if you change your mind at any point, just say. Shall we do the health questions? First, apart from the stroke this year, have you been diagnosed with any heart condition, cancer, or kidney disease in the last five years?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Sorry, heart, cancer and what?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Kidney disease. So heart condition, cancer, or kidney disease, in the last five years.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, none of those. Just high blood pressure, which I take tablets for.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. And are you currently in hospital or waiting for any tests or operations?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No. I finished the physio in August. Just check-ups with my GP now.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, that's all I need. Based on those answers, we can accept you. Looking at the mortgage of about £30,000 plus funeral costs, I'd suggest £50,000 of cover, which comes to £28 a month. That's within the under thirty pounds you mentioned. How does that sound?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Fifty thousand for twenty-eight pounds. Can you say it once more so I'm sure?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Of course. £50,000 of cover, for £28 a month.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes. I think that's right for us. Let me just think a moment.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Take all the time you need.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay. I'm happy with that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Lovely. Before I set it up, let me summarise. Acme Life Cover for £50,000. The premium is £28 a month, fixed for the whole length of the policy. In the first 12 months, only accidental death is covered. After that, death from illness is covered too. And you have 30 days to cancel with a full refund. Would you like to go ahead with that?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes. Yes, I'd like to go ahead.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr Ali. I'll send all of that in writing too, so you and your daughter can read it through together. Is there anything you'd like me to go over again?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, I think I understood it all. Thank you for being patient with me.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: It's been a pleasure. If you have any questions when the documents arrive, just call us. Take care, and best wishes to Samira.
